title: Race condition: counter++
description: Two threads increment without a lock; the lost update gives 1.

input.code:
# counter++ is really three instructions: load, add, store.
shared counter = 0

thread A
  LOAD r, counter
  ADD r, 1
  STORE counter, r

thread B
  LOAD r, counter
  ADD r, 1
  STORE counter, r
